description: Reference data for the TFF Nutrition Plan Skill. The question sequence is defined in SKILL.md. This file holds only options, formulas, tables and worked examples. Every number carries a _source code from reference/sources.md.
goal_options: Combination (e.g. fat loss + endurance, muscle gain + endurance)
supplement_openness_options: Open to supplements if the evidence supports them
sex_for_formula_options: Average of both (intersex, trans, or prefer not to say) — state it as an estimate

resting_energy_mifflin_st_jeor.note: Mifflin-St Jeor was the equation most often within 10 % of measured resting metabolic rate in healthy non-obese and obese adults (Frankenfield 2005). Show the formula with the user's numbers. The result is also the lower hard floor for the daily energy target.

bands.description: Sitting work with some walking or standing

pal_dge.note: Name the band chosen and why. For training volumes well above 4–5 × 30–60 min, say the table covers it poorly and let the weekly weight check calibrate.

fat_loss_lean_trained_sustained_deficit.note: lean, resistance-trained only; start in the lower half

bmi_30_plus_reference_weight.rule: use the weight at BMI 25 for the user's height

carbohydrate_around_sessions.during_over_2_5_to_3h: up to 90 g/h, glucose-fructose, practise first

fluid.after: 1.25–1.5 L per kg lost, with sodium

examples.case: Man, 35, 75 kg, 178 cm, sitting work with some walking (PAL 1.6–1.7 [Q19])
examples.fat_loss_start: ≈ 2,210–2,580 kcal (H1); floors: above 1,693 and above 1,200 → fine

examples.case: Woman, 42, 62 kg, 168 cm, office job + sport 4×/week 45 min (PAL 1.4–1.5 + 0.3 [Q19])
examples.fat_loss_start: ≈ 1,710–2,040 kcal (H1); floors: above 1,299 and above 1,200 → fine

examples.case: Floor hit — woman, 28, 52 kg, 160 cm, office job, no sport (PAL 1.4–1.5), asks for 1,000 kcal
examples.response: 1,000 kcal is below both floors (1,219 resting energy [Q18], 1,200 [Q5]). Lowest possible target 1,219 kcal; BMI 20.3 — offer maintenance, strength training, a goal without a weight number.

examples.case: BMI ≥ 30 — man, 50, 120 kg, 175 cm, fat loss, no strength training
examples.protein: 1.2–1.6 g/kg × 76.6 = 92–123 g/day [Q5] — say that the reference weight is the skill's choice
